name: Greg
source: Greg is a regular at [url=/c176657]Sam[/url]'s Gym. Seems self-absorbed and generally an uncontrollable force. Greg doesn't seem to do much of anything at the gym other than instigate trouble. He is an average boxer with little to no future in the sport.
